answer: A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, because the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the zenith band is published for each class. Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the lagoon audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 193 to 389 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the falcon identity is graded at all. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
